resources.string: AutoTap uses Accessibility to tap/swipe automatically, replay your recorded combos, read the hardware keys you assign and take screenshots for image recognition. All data stays on your device.
Turn on the AutoTap Accessibility service first
Can\'t turn it on? Open app info
Find \"AutoTap\" in the list (it may be under Installed apps) and turn it on
Tap ⋮ (top corner) → \"Allow restricted settings\", then come back and turn on Accessibility
⚠️ Accessibility service is OFF — tap the button below and turn on \"AutoTap\".
Swipe from the LEFT edge to open the combo list (off = right edge)
Position: drag each combo button and the control panel directly on screen (positions are remembered). Visibility 0% = invisible button.
Combo button and control panel positions reset
3. Combos (switch = show button; tap to edit)
No combos yet. On the floating control panel: tap ● to record a combo, or ＋ to add auto-click points.
No image templates are turned on
Screen scan interval: %1$d ms (lower = faster reaction, more battery)
No image templates yet. On the floating control panel, tap the select-area button (✂) to capture the screen and pick the image to recognize.
Click the center of the image
Minimum similarity: %1$d%% (higher = more precise, lower = easier to match)
Allowed position offset around the selected area (px)
Wait before it can trigger again (ms)

• Turn on Accessibility for AutoTap (section 1). The floating UI appears over every app and game.

• COMBO BUTTONS: every enabled combo has its own round button, numbered as in the list. Tap = run / stop. Drag = move. Long-press = quick edit (speed, loops, hardware key…).

• SWIPE IN FROM THE SCREEN EDGE (right edge by default, marked by a small faint bar) to open the COMBO LIST: show/hide the control panel, show/hide each combo button, edit combos, change size & visibility — without leaving your game.

• CONTROL PANEL (toolbar):
 ● Record combo: tap, then use your phone normally (tap, hold, swipe); tap ■ to stop & save. Go steadily, about 0.1 s between touches.
 ＋ / − Add / remove auto-click points. Drag a circle to where you want to click; long-press a circle to delete it.
 ✂ Capture the screen & select the image to recognize.
 👁 Turn image recognition on / off (green = watching).
 ☰ Open the combo list · ⌂ Open the app · ✕ Hide the control panel (combo buttons stay).

• HARDWARE KEY: tap a combo → "Assign key" → press a key (e.g. volume up/down) → choose the press type (single / double / long) → Save. Keys work even when the floating UI is off.

• Combo button visibility 0% = invisible (still tappable). While the control panel is open, invisible buttons are shown faintly so you can see and drag them.
Google sample ad mode: OFF (using your real ad unit)
Drag to move the control panel
Capture & select an image to recognize
Control panel hidden. Combo buttons still work. Swipe in from the %1$s edge of the screen to open the combo list.
Recording combo… Use your phone normally, then tap ■ on the control panel to stop & save.
Saved \"%1$s\" (%2$d actions). Combo button %3$d is now on screen.
Drag the circle to where you want to click. Long-press a circle to delete it. Tap the \"%1$s\" combo button to run.
Created \"%1$s\". Tap ＋ on the control panel to add click points.
No image templates yet. Tap the select-area button (✂) on the control panel to create one.
Couldn\'t capture the screen, try again in a moment
Saved \"%1$s\". Watching — the action runs automatically when the image appears.
Drag your finger to select the image area to recognize.\nWhen this image appears there again, the action runs automatically.
Drag to select a larger area
Floating toolbar (record combo, add points, capture image…)
Turn a switch on to show that combo\'s button on screen. Tap a combo name to edit speed, loops, hardware key…
While the control panel is open, invisible buttons are shown faintly so you can see and drag them. Hide the control panel to make them fully invisible.
Off = swipe from the right edge to open this panel
Long-press actions always keep their original hold time.
Number of loops (0 = loop until you tap stop)
Key: … press the hardware key you want to assign
You can assign the same key to several combos with different press types. For volume keys, unassigned press types still change the volume as usual.
Key received: %1$s. Tap Save to finish.
